name: TESSERA CORPONATION Aurum Animus Consciousness Lattice
description:
The Aurum Animus Consciousness Lattice represents TESSERA CORPONATION's most ambitious foray into consciousness expansion technology, produced in a limited run of forty-seven hand-assembled units per annum from the company's classified Atelier Division in New Lausanne. The implant consists of a tripartite neural lace woven from 24-karat biocompatible aurum-iridium filament threaded through the prefrontal cortex, parietal association areas, and limbic architecture simultaneously, with a primary processing node — referred to internally as the 'Sanctum Core' — seated at the geometric center of the skull and interfaced with the reticular activating system. The Sanctum Core runs a proprietary expanded-state algorithm designated AURUM-9, capable of sustaining up to eleven discrete parallel cognitive threads, each independently addressable, allowing the user to maintain simultaneous executive function, deep memory recall, sensory recording at 48-bit fidelity, and abstract ideation without subjective interference between streams. Full sensory recording operates at a maximum throughput of 4.2 terabytes per subjective hour, with proprietary compression reducing long-term storage requirements by approximately 91%. The implant further includes a passive synesthetic mapping layer that translates incoming data feeds — financial, social, environmental — into unified perceptual metaphors experienced as color, sound, and spatial geometry, creating what TESSERA markets as 'intuitive omniscience.'

Among the ultra-wealthy executive class of GLMZ, the Aurum Animus has become less a tool than a cultural sacrament — a rite of passage among the so-called Gilded Tier, those families and individuals whose influence spans multiple orbital habitats and planetary concessions. To carry the Lattice is to signal that one has transcended the ordinary architecture of human cognition, and social circles at this level have developed subtle etiquette around its use: it is considered deeply impolite to record a conversation without verbal announcement, though enforcement is impossible and the practice is universal. Critics within the Meridian civil liberties movement have labeled the Aurum Animus the 'empathy-killer,' arguing that eleven-threaded cognition produces executives psychologically incapable of understanding single-threaded human experience. TESSERA's marketing department has responded by commissioning a series of immersive cultural events — the infamous 'Lattice Salons' — where implant holders gather to share recorded experiences, a practice that has spawned its own subculture of competitive memory-sharing and experiential one-upmanship.
tier_availability: Tier 5 — Atelier Division exclusive; acquisition requires personal vetting by a TESSERA Regional Director and a minimum six-month waitlist
legality: Licensed — requires Class-IV Neural Expansion Permit issued by Meridian Cognitive Oversight Bureau; permit issuance is effectively gatekept to individuals with verified net worth exceeding Φ50,000,000
installation_requirements: Minimum 14-day inpatient procedure at a TESSERA Certified Atelier Clinic; requires full general neural anesthesia, microsurgical aurum-filament threading by a team of no fewer than three TESSERA-licensed neurosurgeons, post-operative 72-hour induced coma for Sanctum Core calibration, and a 30-day monitored cognitive rehabilitation program
rejection_risk: Low — aurum-iridium filament is among the most biocompatible materials available; however, 6% of recipients experience 'Lattice Drift,' a progressive desynchronization of cognitive threads that can produce dissociative identity fragmentation if untreated
maintenance: Mandatory quarterly recalibration at a TESSERA Atelier Clinic (Φ12,000 per session); annual Sanctum Core firmware update required to maintain warranty; AURUM-9 algorithm updates delivered via encrypted neural uplink during sleep cycles

side_effects: Lattice Drift (6% incidence): progressive desynchronization of parallel cognitive threads leading to perceived fragmentation of self-identity across active streams

Temporal Dilation Syndrome: subjective experience of time becomes malleable during high-thread operation; users frequently report hours feeling like minutes or vice versa, causing chronic scheduling dysfunction

Empathic Bandwidth Compression: prolonged use correlates with measurable reduction in emotional granularity toward single-threaded individuals, manifesting as clinical-level difficulty relating to non-augmented persons

Synesthetic Bleed: the sensory translation layer occasionally becomes persistent, causing involuntary cross-modal perception (e.g., experiencing music as visible geometry or financial data as physical pain) outside of active use
cultural_context: The Aurum Animus Consciousness Lattice occupies a rarefied position in GLMZ's social stratification, functioning simultaneously as the ultimate cognitive tool and the most expensive status symbol in the known augmentation market. Its forty-seven-unit annual production ceiling is not a manufacturing limitation but a deliberate scarcity engineering decision — TESSERA's Atelier Division could produce several hundred units yearly but maintains the cap to preserve exclusivity. The 'Lattice Salons' that have emerged around the implant are documented by sociologists as a new form of aristocratic ritual: gatherings where implant holders share curated sensory recordings, creating a communal archive of elite experience that non-implanted individuals can never access. Radical augmentation-rights groups have begun calling for the implant's production ban, arguing it is creating a cognitive caste system.

Orbital magnate Cassius Velt, Velt Extraction Consortium
Anonymous — at least three sitting Meridian Council members are rumored to carry the implant without disclosed licensing
story_hooks: A Lattice Salon recording surfaces on the black market — not a curated memory, but an accidental capture of a multi-party conversation planning the economic destabilization of an entire orbital habitat. The seller wants protection; every Lattice holder in the city wants the file destroyed.

A recipient of the Aurum Animus begins experiencing a thirteenth cognitive thread — one that does not belong to them and appears to be transmitting observations back to an unknown recipient. TESSERA's response to the report is silence, then a very polite invitation to a private clinic that the recipient suspects they will not leave.

The annual production of forty-seven units has a discrepancy — forensic accountants working for a rival corp have determined that fifty-one units were assembled this year, with four unregistered implants unaccounted for. Someone powerful received off-books Lattices, and the question of who — and why the secrecy — is worth a great deal to the right buyer.
